hypothesis: A 50/50 book of time-series trend (mean sign of 20/60/120-day returns, inverse-vol) and weekly cross-sectional momentum (30-day return skipping 1 day, long top third / short bottom third), each scaled to 20% annual vol, earns a positive risk-adjusted net return on Binance USDT perps, measured only on live paper data from the forward start.
rulesChosenFrom: Copied unchanged from the engine-py research lab (experiment.yaml trend and xsmom blocks; xsmom = EXP-000015). Both sleeves have already been evaluated on 2024-07 to 2026-09 data, including the H2 window from 2025-10-01, so no historical period is clean for them. Daily bars replace engine-py's hourly bars: vol uses daily returns and fills are at the next daily open.
survivorshipNote: The universe is today's listed perps, so the reference backtest has survivorship bias. A coin trades once it has 120 daily closes (trend) or 31 (cross-sectional) and a 30-day vol.
costNote: 7 bps per side = Binance USDT-M taker 5 bps + ~2 bps half-spread, charged on every change in weight. Funding is not charged in this version's simulation; it is reported as a known gap.
execution: Weights decided on the daily close (00:00 UTC); held from the next day's open. Trend rebalances daily; cross-sectional on days since epoch divisible by 7. Paper only.

acceptance.benchmark: equal-weight, daily-rebalanced long of the same symbols

noRetuning: The reference backtest is printed for sanity only and is NOT out-of-sample. No parameter may change after this file is committed; a change means a new version judged on new live data.
